subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs-generation PR should be the canonical implementation path for this issue?
rationale: The requested work remains valid, but two open PRs implement overlapping generator/check paths and both need maintainer selection or refresh before the issue can close.

options.title: Refresh and land the stronger proven PR
options.body: Refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 on current main, resolve conflicts, rerun proof, and use it as the canonical fix.

options.title: Repair the same-author PR
options.body: Ask https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91612 to address proof and formatter concerns, resolve conflicts, and land that branch instead.

options.title: Request one narrow replacement
options.body: Close or pause the competing PRs and ask for one fresh focused generator/check PR if neither branch is worth adopting.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land the stronger proven PR
recommendation.body: Refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 on current main, resolve conflicts, rerun proof, and use it as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent stabilization history on the credential matrix docs surface and is the best available routing owner for choosing between overlapping implementation branches.
